_note: Episode 44 (S5E3), story version 2 Kabanata 44. Present day, Manila Bay and the Pasig mouth, the first battle; Usman present. Indio in his forties (string of Episodes 48 and 49). Diwa are light only, no clear face, never a likeness of a real person. The "faces from billboards" are drawn as generic smiling masks that fall away to empty shadows; no real person, party or brand. Battle shown as walls, light, masks falling and smoke; nobody is hit. Rico (older) from Episode 17, Tubal (older) from Episode 16. empty_shadow is a montage extra. Shot 8 repeats Sulayman's diwa and shot 55 the 1570 window: their own prompts came back as collages.
